info.name: Jazz & Blues
info.description: Swing, shuffle, blues in 12/8, a 12 bar organ blues and a blues shuffle song.

songs.name: Blues Shuffle
songs.description: A 12 measure blues shuffle in A at 90 BPM, in triplets, all synth sounds: the turnaround as intro, three choruses of measures 1-4, 5-8 and 9-12, then the ending. The drums come in after two measures; in the second chorus the piano takes a solo over a softer organ; in the third the organ comes back up, and the last chord rings into the reverb.

patterns.name: Blues 12/8
patterns.description: Slow blues in 12/8, 1 measure: closed hats on every triplet accented on the beat, kick on 1, the last triplet of 2 and 3, snare on 2 and 4; triplet tom fill on 4 every 4 passes, crash on 1 every 8.

patterns.name: Blues Organ 12 Bar
patterns.description: Slow 12/8 blues, 12 measures: drawbar organ on the 12-bar form in C (C7 x4, F7 x2, C7 x2, G7, F7, C7, G7), chords on 1 and 3 with a short pickup on the last triplet.

patterns.name: Jazz Swing
patterns.description: Jazz swing on a triplet grid, 1 measure: ride on 1, 2, the last triplet of 2, 3, 4 and the last triplet of 4, hi-hat foot on 2 and 4, feathered kick on every beat, snare comping on the last triplets every 2 to 4 passes.

patterns.name: Shuffle
patterns.description: Shuffle on a triplet grid, 1 measure: kick on 1 and 3 with a last-triplet pickup, snare on 2 and 4, shuffled closed hats, open hat on each &; triplet snare fills every 4 passes.

patterns.name: Swing 16ths
patterns.description: Swung 16ths, 1 measure: kick on 1, 2&, 3 and 4&, snare and clap together on 1& and 2e of every 2 beats, 16th open hats, closed hat every 3 beats; tom and cowbell figures every 2 to 8 passes.

patterns.name: Blues Shuffle 1-4
patterns.description: Measures 1 to 4 of the Blues Shuffle demo, a 12 measure blues in A at 90 BPM in triplets, all synth sounds: A7 four times; kick on 1 and 3, a brush snare on 2 and 4 with ghosts, a shuffled ride, a boogie bass (root, 5th, 6th, 5th), shuffled organ comping and two piano licks in the blues scale.

patterns.name: Blues Shuffle 5-8
patterns.description: Measures 5 to 8 of the Blues Shuffle demo: D7, D7, A7, A7, the boogie bass following, a piano lick climbing over D7 and one falling back to A.

patterns.name: Blues Shuffle 9-12
patterns.description: Measures 9 to 12 of the Blues Shuffle demo, the turnaround: E7, D7, A7, E7, a chromatic piano run down from A and the climb back to E for the next chorus.

patterns.name: Blues Shuffle Ending
patterns.description: The ending of the Blues Shuffle demo: E7, D7, the chromatic run down to A, a tom fill and the last hit on A7 with a crash, ringing.
